7. Out of the total expenditure of ₹275083.75 crore on Pay and Allowances of
Central Government Civilian Employees including employees of UTs and Missions
Abroad, the percentage expenditure on Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent
Allowance (HRA) and other allowances are 60.45%, 21.04%, 5.56% and 12.95%
respectively.
8. Out of the total expenditure of ₹ 15285.50 crore on HRA in 2022-23, the HRA
expenditure for 'X' class cities is 5669.64 crore which is around 37.09% of the total
expenditure on HRA.
9. The total number of regular Central Government Civilian Employees in
position (including UTs) as on 01.03.2023, is 30.62 lakh as against the sanctioned
strength of 40.40 lakh and approximately 24.21 % of the posts were vacant.
10. Almost 92% of the total manpower is covered by five major
Ministries/Departments viz, Railways, Defence (Civil), Home Affairs, Posts and
Revenue. Of the total strength of 30.04 lakh (excluding UTs), the percentage share
of the Railways is 39.06%, Home Affairs 32.78%, Defence (Civil) 11.11%, Posts
5.91%, Revenue 3.55% and all other Ministries/ Departments 7.59%.
11. Against the sanctioned strength of 10.37 lakh in Central Police Forces, 9.33
lakh employees were in position as on 01.03.2023. In Union Territories (UTs) 0.58
lakhs employees were in position as against a sanctioned strength of 0.79 lakhs as
on 01.03.2023.
